notes.title: "Heroes Strategy · Cards" community activities
notes.content:
Activity time: long-term effective

Activities
1. Community screenshot package: Players can receive it by posting content in the community center - screenshot function;
2. Community artwork package: Players can receive it by posting content in the community center - artwork function.

Gift Package Contents (worth ￥300)
Screenshot gift package: card draw coupon*10, skill draw coupon*10, stamina*66
Art work gift package: card draw coupon*10, skill draw coupon*10, ingot*66

Receive gifts
1. Players who have achieved the achievement can reply "Completed" below, and then the administrator will add your friend and send it to you in private chat;
2. Each gift pack can only be used once by each player and cannot be used repeatedly.
